title: Voice aliases
note: What people actually say out loud, mapped to rows (ai_entity_alias).
sql: SELECT a.entity_type, a.alias, a.alias_kind, CASE a.entity_type WHEN 'customer' THEN (SELECT full_name FROM customer WHERE customer_id = a.entity_id) WHEN 'product' THEN (SELECT name FROM product WHERE product_id = a.entity_id) WHEN 'employee' THEN (SELECT full_name FROM employee WHERE employee_id = a.entity_id) END AS resolves_to FROM ai_entity_alias a ORDER BY a.entity_type, a.alias
